name: Météo-France Radar
description: Official real-time Météo-France radar catalog and latest products for mainland and overseas France. Discover operational stations and five-minute station or mosaic observations such as reflectivity and accumulated rainfall. Access is free after self-service portal signup and subscription; the integration automatically obtains short-lived OAuth tokens.

credential_fields.name: application_id
credential_fields.label: Météo-France application identifier
credential_fields.description: Create an application at portail-api.meteofrance.fr, subscribe it to Données Radar, and copy the APPLICATION_ID used with HTTP Basic authentication.

tools.name: list_operational_stations
tools.description: List radar stations currently operational and available through the API as JSON.

tools.name: get_station
tools.description: Get catalog metadata and links for one operational radar station.

station_id.description: Météo-France radar station identifier returned by list_operational_stations.

tools.name: list_station_observations
tools.description: List observation products currently available for one radar station.

tools.name: get_station_observation
tools.description: Get metadata and validity time for the latest selected station observation, such as REFLECTIVITE, PAM, or PAG.

tools.name: download_station_product
tools.description: Download the most recent binary product for a station observation. The returned data format is described by get_station_observation.

tools.name: list_mosaics
tools.description: List available radar mosaic zones for mainland and overseas France.

tools.name: list_mosaic_observations
tools.description: List current observation products for a radar mosaic zone such as METROPOLE.

zone.description: Mosaic zone returned by list_mosaics, commonly METROPOLE.

tools.name: get_mosaic_observation
tools.description: Get metadata and validity time for a current mosaic observation such as reflectivity or accumulated rainfall.

observation.description: Observation identifier returned by list_mosaic_observations, for example LAME_D_EAU.

tools.name: download_mosaic_product
tools.description: Download the latest binary mosaic product. For supported rainfall mosaics, maille selects grid resolution in metres, for example 500.

maille.description: Optional grid size in metres when supported, for example 500.
